agent_rules: Treat the postulate as normative unless a newer version is explicitly supplied.
Never duplicate canonical product attributes inside the Manita configuration.
Never invent eligibility, dietary status, cost, stock, shelf life or supplier data.
Prefer FULL_MATRIX. Use CONSTRAINED_MATRIX only when economic validation fails.
Always compute or request worst_case_bundle_cost before declaring a catalog valid.
For dietary requests, require one valid item in every family.
Return DATA_INCOMPLETE when critical fields are missing rather than fabricating a decision.
